name: Shoko Otaki
source:
Short of stature but tall in confidence, Shoko moderates with an unwavering dedication to the sanctity of online discourse. His unmistakable flair for the dramatic, coupled with his unique writing style, have struck fear and irritation into the hearts of countless virtual undesirables.

Shoko is an administrator on almost 40 different online communities. The massive volume of moderation work has stretched the limits of both his mind and body, yet he continues to accept new jobs on a monthly basis. Shoko claims that his contributions are necessary for the preservation of nationwide justice, if not the nation itself; a sentiment obviously shared by the Academy's Admissions Office, who extended an offer to him before almost any other candidate.

In attending Bitokukawa, Shoko has one goal in mind - to be taken seriously as an enforcer of Internet law. Despite his tendency to lightly butt heads with his peers, it is no doubt that they will grow to appreciate his indomitable work ethic and his rapier wit.

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/danganronpa/comments/1g1jprj/meet_shoko_the_former_ultimate_forum_admin/]bio[/url]]
